name: Keep the grounds for a public claim in view

uses.action: Hang the dated reading on one hook and the two-coin proposal on another. Keep either hook in place while replacing the other. A demand to spend the evening does not supply the evidence for the count.

name: Give an ambiguous word a working observation

uses.action: Open all twelve dated bed views. Compare what the word living selects on planting night and after frost, then light both springs at the same date.

name: Separate what happened from what should happen

uses.action: Send any of three checked readings with any of three purchases. Spending the evening on shade, a dance or another visit is a separate decision from what the panes show.

name: Test how much a simple cause can explain

uses.action: Run a bare tub and a growing sapling across chalk with the same boot. Hang up the boot and run both loads again. The moving cart can account for the prints without identifying a night caller.

name: Use the same steps to compare changing conditions

uses.action: Keep the load when changing the heel, then keep the heel when changing the load. Four separately retained trials let a second person inspect the same effect.

name: Read the same change from another person’s position

uses.action: Take both turns in the installed square. A nursery carter and a caller use the same roof, procession or return bench for different ends. Choose who directs its next use.

name: Locate the value decision in a public threshold

uses.action: For a grower who lends only the total, try a grouping with enough people. The counting rule passes it, but the permission rule still keeps the detail inside. Carry the roll closed or fold to the permitted count.

name: Catch one word moving between two meanings

uses.action: The old lantern’s living trees were tubs counted at planting. The new lantern counts witnessed leaves. Superimpose the mismatched posters, then compare two planting panes and two frost panes.

name: Distinguish a persuasive image from a warranted reading

uses.action: Try the dramatic poster, then hang a pair of matched dates above the same coins. Each published pane carries its own stated limit, including the evidence the parade cannot supply.

name: Track who still has no return record

uses.action: At each of the three beds distinguish closed pages, actual losses and missing spring returns. Count the witnesses on both dates before treating the seven new leaf marks as a rise or fall.

name: Assess what a grouped count can disclose

uses.action: Try a dozen invented volunteers behind three shutters. Open them together, compare one mark with a group of three, and reserve only permitted aggregates, or a fully closed roll.

name: Compare two seasons under a common measure

uses.action: Join matched spade and frost readings, keeping lost tubs and unknown entries distinct. Twelve and seven in the original posters do not establish five losses.
